assessments.reasoning: I independently retrieved and verified the exact bytes of ALGOL 68 Compiler for the DEC PDP11 Computers and inspected the cited passage (ALGOL Bulletin 42, printed p. 3, PDP11 compiler notice, third paragraph (archive AB42.1.3, printed heading AB41.1.3)). limitations: The identity is scoped to the formal IFIP sublanguage. The source records both numbering forms.
